calculation.description: Measures recent 20-day return relative to the average preceding 40-day trend, scaled by lagged 30-day daily-return volatility. Positive values indicate recent trend acceleration; all inputs are lagged one completed day. Cross-sectional ranking is intended for portfolio use.
